uncovered_shapes.sentence: Tony Blevins, then head of procurement, threatened a Sandisk salesman and said he would have Sandisk’s chief executive, Sanjay Mehrotra, crawl on his knees back to Apple, according to a person familiar with the call.

claims.claim: Google said on October 28 it is launching a preview of the Connected Apps Platform, with more than 50 Connected Apps already live in Gemini and Search.
claims.episode_span: with more than 50 Connected Apps already live between the two
claims.source_title: Google Opens Gemini and Search to Apps, Bars Their Ads
claims.supporting_quote: Google said on 28 October it is “launching the preview of our Connected Apps Platform, a unified way for more app developers to bring their capabilities directly into Gemini and Search”, with more than 50 Connected Apps already live between the two.

claims.claim: Google's Connected Apps Policy says partners must not serve third-party advertising through their integrations.
claims.episode_span: partners must not serve any third-party advertising or promotional material
claims.source_title: Google Opens Gemini and Search to Apps, Bars Their Ads
claims.supporting_quote: Its Connected Apps Policy says partners “must not serve any third party advertising content or promotional material through their integrations”.

claims.claim: Sundar Pichai’s figure this week was one billion Gemini app users.
claims.episode_span: Sundar Pichai’s figure this week was one billion Gemini app users
claims.source_title: Google Opens Gemini and Search to Apps, Bars Their Ads
claims.supporting_quote: Sundar Pichai’s own figure this week was one billion Gemini app users, less than a quarter of that, by our arithmetic.

claims.claim: On October 29 Alphabet said it is expanding ads in AI Mode into international markets and multi-turn ads in AI Mode in the U.S., and that AI Mode query growth had an impact because of lower monetization.
claims.episode_span: expanding ads in AI Mode into international markets, alongside multi-turn ads in AI Mode in the U.S.
claims.source_title: Google Opens Gemini and Search to Apps, Bars Their Ads
claims.supporting_quote: On Alphabet’s earnings call on 29 October, the company said: “Today we are announcing the expansion of ads in AI Mode into international markets, alongside multi-turn ads in AI Mode in the U.S.” It also said “the strong growth in AI Mode queries had an impact because of the lower monetization we were seeing in AI Mode”.

claims.claim: Apple said iOS 27.3 testing for Apple Intelligence in mainland China starts November 4, with a public release in December.
claims.episode_span: testing of the first wave starts November 4, 2026
claims.source_title: Apple Confirms iOS 27.3 Beta Release Date With Apple Intelligence in China
claims.supporting_quote: According to Apple’s official announcement , testing starts November 4 through its latest developer beta, with the public release scheduled for December.

claims.claim: Alibaba said user requests and generated replies sent through the Qwen integration will not be used to train its models, and Apple asks for consent before content is sent to Qwen.

claims.supporting_quote: user requests and generated replies will not be used to train its models

claims.claim: Counterpoint Research said combined global sales of the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max rose 3.1 percent in the first three weeks, with China up 29 percent, the U.S. down 4 percent, and Japan down 27 percent.
claims.episode_span: rose 3.1 percent in their first three weeks
claims.source_title: iPhone 18 Pro Sales Surge in China, Offsetting Decline in U.S. and Japan
claims.supporting_quote: Combined global sales of the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max rose 3.1% during their first three weeks of availability compared with the equivalent launch period last year. U.S. sales fell 4%, while Japan recorded a 27% decline.

claims.claim: Apple raised U.S. starting prices by 100 dollars, to 1,199 dollars for the iPhone 18 Pro and 1,299 dollars for the Pro Max.
claims.episode_span: bringing the Pro to 1,199 dollars and the Pro Max to 1,299 dollars
claims.source_title: iPhone 18 Pro Sales Surge in China, Offsetting Decline in U.S. and Japan
claims.supporting_quote: Apple raised starting prices by 100 in the U.S., bringing the Pro to 1,199 and the Pro Max to 1,299.

claims.claim: HomeView Software 27.2 was released ahead of a November 13 launch, and the HomeView is priced at 299 dollars.
claims.episode_span: priced at 299 dollars, with pre-orders open
claims.source_title: HomeView Software 27.2: Wallpapers, Control Center, and More
claims.supporting_quote: The HomeView is priced at 299, and it can be pre-ordered from Apple's website. It will launch alongside the fourth-generation Apple TV 4K on November 13.

claims.supporting_quote: Microsoft has given the group, Washington Needs to Compete, more than $5 million of the $13.8 million it has raised.

claims.claim: Two years ago Apple bought nearly twice the flash storage of Microsoft, Amazon, Meta and Google combined, and hyperscalers are now buying double Apple's share, according to TechInsights estimates cited by the Wall Street Journal.
claims.episode_span: nearly twice the flash storage of Microsoft, Amazon, Meta, and Google combined
claims.source_title: Apple's Flash Storage Suppliers Are Finally 'Getting Their Revenge'
claims.supporting_quote: Two years ago, Apple bought nearly twice the flash storage of Microsoft, Amazon, Meta and Google combined, according to TechInsights estimates," the report said, citing a research firm. "Hyperscalers are now buying double Apple's share."

claims.claim: TechInsights estimated Apple's gross profit on a 200-dollar iPhone 18 Pro storage upgrade from 256GB to 512GB is 134 dollars, down from 185 dollars on the equivalent iPhone 17 Pro upgrade.
claims.episode_span: a gross profit of 134 dollars when a customer spends 200 dollars
claims.source_title: Apple's Flash Storage Suppliers Are Finally 'Getting Their Revenge'
claims.supporting_quote: TechInsights estimated that Apple makes a gross profit of 134 when a customer spends 200 to upgrade an iPhone 18 Pro from 256GB to 512GB of storage, down from 185 when a customer opted for the equivalent upgrade for the iPhone 17 Pro last year.
